## F07.data-retention — Data retention and privacy

Definition: Retention terms, training use, zero-retention options.
- claude-code [partial, verified] For Free, Pro and Max accounts, data is used to train new models when the setting is on, including Claude Code use. The default retention period is 30 days and the minimum is 1. Retention of team task lists follows the same cleanupPeriodDays setting you control for session transcripts. Deleting a cloud session permanently removes the session and its data. | limit: The default is 30 days and the minimum is 1; setting 0 fails with a validation error. | ev: E-claude-code-07596, E-claude-code-06843, E-claude-code-01537, E-claude-code-06787
- codex-cli [supported, verified] No training on your business data by default. history.persistence and history.max_bytes are the local settings to review if you don't want Codex to save session transcripts under CODEX_HOME. A requirements.toml setting can require Codex service traffic to use a supported data residency (currently accepts us). Trusted Access does not automatically grant Zero Data Retention. | ev: E-codex-cli-02020, E-codex-cli-00160, E-codex-cli-00848, E-codex-cli-01109
- copilot-cli [partial, verified] Anthropic retains prompts and outputs by default when Claude Fable 5 or 5.1 is used; customers can request zero data retention for them through the end of 2026 under a time-bound exemption. Copilot will not use an indexed repository for model training. /session delete-all and /session prune do not delete synced data. | limit: Zero data retention for Claude Fable 5 or 5.1 can be requested "through the end of 2026 under a time-bound exemption"; Anthropic retains their prompts and outputs "by default". | ev: E-copilot-cli-00783, E-copilot-cli-00796, E-copilot-cli-02094, E-copilot-cli-02768
- copilot-vscode [supported, verified] The model configuration option `zeroDataRetentionEnabled` (default `false`) is set to `true` if Zero Data Retention (ZDR) is enabled for the endpoint; then `previous_response_id` is not sent in Responses API requests. By default, no prompt content, responses, or tool arguments are captured. Setting `chat.sessionSync.enabled` to `false` keeps session data local only. | ev: E-copilot-vscode-00209, E-copilot-vscode-00485, E-copilot-vscode-02659
- cursor [partial, verified] Enterprise customers can enroll in US-only data residency. CMEK can be enabled for encryption with your own keys when your compliance program requires it (Cloud Agent data). Some models are marked as requiring data retention approval for Enterprise customers, Teams and individual customers with Privacy Mode enabled. | limit: A few models require data retention with the provider and fall outside these agreements. Requests through a cyber-verified model run with Privacy Mode off for that model only; Cursor cannot honor zero data retention for those requests. | ev: E-cursor-00754, E-cursor-00021, E-cursor-00055, E-cursor-00775, E-cursor-00001
- gemini-cli [supported, verified] Google does not use your data to improve Google's machine learning models if you (condition cut off in the quote). By default, Gemini CLI automatically cleans up old session data. The 'Delete session on exit' scenario uses the --delete flag when exiting.
